name: developer-learning-toolkit
description: Learning diagnostics, interactive career roadmaps, mastery planning, and mock interviews for software developers.

interface.shortDescription: Build, track, and test a technical roadmap
interface.longDescription: Map your development context, diagnose where learning stalls, build an interactive roadmap for a technology or career transition, and practice completed capabilities in adaptive mock interviews. The toolkit uses observable mastery evidence and does not provide psychological diagnoses.
defaultPrompt: Map my work context, then help me understand how I learn.
Проведи диагностику моей системы обучения на русском языке.
Build a detailed roadmap from my current skills to a new technology, role, or responsibility level.
Run a mock interview using the capabilities I completed in my roadmap.
